description: The Google keywords a domain (or URL) ranks for in one country, sorted by estimated traffic: keyword, position, ranking URL, search volume, CPC and estimated visits. Up to 100 keywords per call, plus position distribution totals. Billed per call with data.

country.description: 2-letter country code (US, GB, DE...) or English name. Default US.

language.description: Language code, e.g. en, es, de. Default en.

name: ranked_keywords
title: Keywords a domain ranks for
